description:
An invalid code point in a utf8 segment panics the runtime (ir_runtime.rs:694, 'invalid codepoint') on interp/run/build; try cannot catch it. The BEAM raises badarg (ArgumentError), which json.erl relies on. Reproducer: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/38_bs_utf8_construct_badarg.fz

Part of fz-mue (fz runs OTP's json.erl unchanged). Port and harness: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/.
title: Constructing <<cp::utf8>> with an invalid code point raises ArgumentError
